name: Backpressure
summary: Treat repeated friction as information about a mismatched model, interface, dependency, or scope.
purpose: Stop spending force on a blocked execution path, identify the boundary producing resistance, and change the controlling variable rather than repeating the same attempt.
use_when: The same failure recurs despite retries.
Queues, context, coordination, dependencies, or interfaces are accumulating pressure.
Increasing effort produces less useful output.
avoid_when: The failure is transient and a bounded retry policy has not been exhausted.
Stopping the current path would create greater immediate harm than stabilizing it.

procedure.operation: Stop unbounded retries and preserve the latest failure evidence.
Describe the pressure signal as an observable change in latency, errors, queue depth, context size, coordination cost, or output quality.
Classify the boundary as model, interface, dependency, capacity, authority, scope, or unknown.
Identify the smallest upstream assumption capable of producing the repeated pressure.
Change one controlling variable or reduce the load crossing the boundary.
Run a bounded release test and define the condition for continuing, escalating, or abandoning the path.

invariants: The latest failure evidence is preserved before changing the path.
Only one controlling variable changes in the release test when practical.
Backpressure is a signal to investigate, not proof of a specific cause.

failure_modes.mode: Every obstacle is romanticized as meaningful backpressure.
failure_modes.mitigation: Require an observable repeated signal and compare against a bounded transient-failure baseline.

failure_modes.mode: The system reduces load while leaving the true dependency failure untouched.
failure_modes.mitigation: State a falsifiable controlling hypothesis and verify that the release test changes the pressure signal.

provenance.title: Backpressure Protocol
provenance.qualification: The public contract narrows a broad source document to measurable system behavior.

limitations: Boundary classification can be wrong when observability is weak.
Reducing pressure can hide a latent defect rather than fix it.
Distributed systems may have multiple coupled bottlenecks that cannot be isolated in one experiment.

attempts: Sent the complete repository context three times.

output.pressure_signal: Context size rises while plan completeness falls.
output.controlling_hypothesis: Unfiltered repository context displaces execution-critical requirements.
output.release_test: Provide only acceptance criteria, dependency graph, and files in the predicted blast radius.
output.next_action: Compile a minimal context pack and rerun once.
output.stop_condition: Escalate if the reduced context still omits acceptance criteria.
